name: forklight
description: Delegate persistent coding tasks to external Workers while Codex remains the accountable orchestrator.

interface.longDescription: ForkLight lets Codex submit bounded coding jobs to persistent external-model Workers, observe progress, inspect diffs and tests, and resume interrupted work without giving up final review responsibility.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this bounded coding task with ForkLight.
Review the latest ForkLight result before integration.
Compare multiple models on this implementation task.
